# NostaNES

> NostaNES is a web-based NES (Nintendo Entertainment System) super game collection and retro gaming emulator. It runs classic 8-bit games directly in modern web browsers using WebAssembly with zero installation, zero plugins, full gamepad support, CRT shaders, save states, cheat codes, and adaptive mobile touch controls.

Website: https://nostanes.com
Category: Retro Gaming, Web-based Emulation, 8-Bit Nintendo Entertainment System
License/Usage: Free to play in browser; supports loading local user ROMs (.nes and .zip)

---

## Overview

NostaNES provides an authentic, high-performance arcade console experience for playing classic NES games online. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Nostalgist.js (Libretro WebAssembly core), NostaNES delivers 60 FPS cycle-accurate emulation with minimal audio latency, customizable CRT scanline shaders, full multi-slot save/load states, Game Genie cheats, and comprehensive input support (Keyboard, Gamepad, and Mobile Touch).

---

## Key Features

### 1. Zero-Install In-Browser Emulation
- Runs 100% client-side via WebAssembly (Wasm) and HTML5 Canvas.
- No emulator software, plugins, extensions, or account sign-ups required.
- Fast boot and instant play across desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.

### 2. Cloud Game Collection & Local ROM Support
- **Cloud Library**: Curated catalog of NES cartridges organized with metadata, region badges (USA, Europe, Japan, World), release years, and alternative version selections.
- **Local ROM Player**: Drag-and-drop or file picker support for any local `.nes` or `.zip` ROM files. Local ROMs are processed completely in the browser for total privacy.

### 3. Save & Load States
- Instant state saving and restoring powered by browser IndexedDB (`nostanes_save_states`).
- Up to 3 independent save slots per game.
- Slot preview with timestamps, file size, and quick load directly from the game launcher or in-game pause menu.

### 4. Built-in Cheat Engine
- Pre-loaded Game Genie and Pro Action Replay cheat database for popular NES titles.
- In-game cheat manager allowing players to toggle individual cheats on and off during live gameplay (e.g., Infinite Lives, Invincibility, Level Select, Moon Jump).
- Custom cheat code entry supporting Game Genie format (6-character or 8-character codes) and raw memory address patches.

### 5. CRT & Visual Shaders
Customizable real-time visual filters tailored for modern displays:
- **Crisp Pixel (1:1 RAW)**: Pixel-perfect, unfiltered arcade presentation.
- **CRT Scanlines**: Authentic horizontal phosphor scanlines mimicking a classic 1990s cathode-ray tube television.
- **Arcade Cabinet**: Curved screen distortion with corner vignette and aperture grille mask.
- **Warm Vintage NTSC**: Warm retro color grading with soft television blur.
- **Smooth Bilinear**: Bilinear filtering that softens pixel aliasing for high-resolution screens.
- **Monochrome Dot Matrix**: Retro greenish LCD phosphor palette inspired by classic handheld screens.

### 6. Comprehensive Gamepad & Controller Support
- Native Gamepad API integration for Xbox Wireless Controllers, PlayStation (DualShock 4 & DualSense with dynamic SVG glyphs), Nintendo Switch Pro Controllers, and generic USB/Bluetooth HID gamepads.
- Zero-latency input polling with plug-and-play controller detection.
- Customizable button remapping per player.
- Hold Xbox/PS Guide or Select button to open in-game menu; hold for 5 seconds to exit.

### 7. Adaptive & Fully Customizable Mobile Touch Controls
- **In-Game Touch Controls Editor**: Direct on-screen `LAYOUT` button allows real-time customization of touch controls during gameplay:
  - **Drag-and-Drop Repositioning**: Freely move any individual control (D-Pad, NES A, NES B, Turbo A, Turbo B, Select, Start, and Menu) to any position on screen.
  - **Live Scale Slider**: Dynamically resize any button between **50% and 180%** with live visual feedback.
  - **Per-Game Browser Storage**: Custom layouts automatically persist per game in browser `localStorage` (`nostanes_touch_layout_v1_${gameKey}`).
  - **Independent Portrait & Landscape Layouts**: Separate, optimized button geometries for portrait and landscape orientations (portrait isolates controls below the screen; landscape enables immersive edge-to-edge gaming).
  - **Preset Actions**: "Reset Selected", "Reset All" to defaults, and "Apply to All Games".
- **Clean Floating Controls**: Minimal, arcade-authentic cross D-pad and crisp action buttons without bulky circular background discs.
- **Context Menu & Long-Press Suppression**: Full suppression of native long-tap context menus, iOS selection callouts, and text highlighting across mobile browsers.
- **Multi-Touch & Haptic Feedback**: Pointer capture with authentic tactile vibration on touch down and button releases.

### 8. Dual-Mode Fullscreen Engine
- **Cross-Browser Compatibility**: Seamless dual-mode architecture:
  - **Native Fullscreen API**: Used on desktop browsers, Android Chrome/Firefox, and iPadOS.
  - **Simulated Viewport Fullscreen Fallback**: Automatically activates on iOS Chrome and Safari on iPhone (which restrict standard DOM Fullscreen API), locking background scrolling, expanding the game canvas, hiding header HUDs, and flipping toggle states to `Exit FS`.
- **Automatic Screen Wake-Lock**: Prevents mobile and desktop displays from dimming or sleeping during active gameplay sessions.

### 9. 2-Player Local Multiplayer
- Support for simultaneous 2-player local gaming via dual gamepads or split keyboard bindings (Player 1 on Arrows + ZX, Player 2 on Numpad).

### 10. Favorites & Library Organization
- Fast instant search by title, tags, or filename.
- Region filtering (All, USA, Europe, Japan, World).
- Persistent favorites pinning saved in browser storage.

## Controls Reference

### Player 1 (Default Keyboard)
| Action | Key |
|--------|-----|
| D-Pad Up / Down / Left / Right | Arrow Keys (↑ / ↓ / ← / →) |
| NES B Button | Z |
| NES A Button | X |
| Turbo B Button | A |
| Turbo A Button | S |
| Select Button | Right Shift / Left Shift |
| Start Button | Enter |
| In-Game Menu | Escape (Esc) |
| Fullscreen Toggle | F |

### Player 2 (Default Keyboard)
| Action | Key |
|--------|-----|
| D-Pad Up / Down / Left / Right | Numpad 5 / 2 / 1 / 3 |
| NES B Button | Numpad 8 |
| NES A Button | Numpad 7 |
| Turbo B Button | Numpad Minus (-) |
| Turbo A Button | Numpad Plus (+) |
| Select Button | Numpad 0 |
| Start Button | Numpad Enter |

### Gamepad Controls (Xbox / PlayStation / Generic)
| NES Action | Xbox / Generic | PlayStation |
|------------|----------------|-------------|
| D-Pad Movement | D-Pad / Left Stick | D-Pad / Left Stick |
| NES A Button | A Button | Cross (✕) |
| NES B Button | X Button | Square (□) |
| Turbo A Button | Y Button | Triangle (△) |
| Turbo B Button | B Button | Circle (○) |
| Select Button | View / Back | Share / Create |
| Start Button | Menu / Start | Options |
| In-Game Menu | Guide / Home Button | PS Button |
| Fullscreen Toggle | Right Stick Click (R3) | Right Stick Click (R3) |

### Mobile Touch Controls
| Action | Touch Control Element | Description |
|---|---|---|
| D-Pad Movement | 8-Way Cross D-Pad | Smooth multi-directional angle tracking & diagonal inputs |
| NES A Button | Button A | Primary action / confirm (arcade-style circular button) |
| NES B Button | Button B | Secondary action / run (arcade-style circular button) |
| Turbo A Button | Turbo A | Automatic rapid-fire A (amber arcade button) |
| Turbo B Button | Turbo B | Automatic rapid-fire B (amber arcade button) |
| Select / Start | Select & Start Pills | Angled pill buttons with authentic NES tactile labels |
| In-Game Menu | MENU Button | Opens save/load slots, CRT shaders, and cheats |
| Customization | LAYOUT Button | Opens live drag-and-drop position and scale editor |
| Fullscreen Toggle | FULL / EXIT FS | Dual-mode fullscreen toggle (native + simulated fallback) |

## Technical Architecture

```
Frontend Client (Next.js 16 App Router + React 19)
 │
 ├── 3D WaveField Background (Three.js WebGL)
 ├── Game Shelf & Carousel Navigation (Keyboard / Gamepad / Mouse)
 ├── Emulator Container (Nostalgist.js + Libretro Wasm Core)
 │    ├── Audio Pipeline (Web Audio API 2A03 APU emulation)
 │    ├── Video Output (HTML5 Canvas + CRT Fragment Shaders)
 │    ├── Input Layer (Gamepad API / KeyboardEvent / Touch PointerCapture & Customizer)
 │    └── State & Layout Managers (IndexedDB `nostanes_save_states` & LocalStorage touch layouts)
 │
 └── Next.js Server & Edge APIs
      ├── /api/library  ──> Catalog listing with region and version grouping
      ├── /api/rom      ──> Streaming ROM binary distribution (Cloudflare R2)
      └── /api/cheats   ──> Game Genie and memory cheat database
```

### Core Technologies:
- **Next.js 16.4** with Turbopack, App Router, React 19, and TypeScript.
- **Nostalgist.js 0.23** wrapping Libretro emulation cores (FCEUmm / Nestopia) in WebAssembly.
- **Tailwind CSS v4** & Base UI for high-contrast, accessible UI design.
- **Motion (Framer Motion v14)** for smooth 60 FPS transitions and console navigation.
- **Three.js** for background ambient graphics and shader foundations.
- **Cloudflare R2 Object Storage** (AWS S3 SDK client) for low-latency streaming of ROM files.

---

## API Endpoints

### 1. `GET /api/library`
Returns the complete list of available games in JSON format.
- **Response Format**: Array of `Game` objects:
  ```json
  [
    {
      "id": "Super Mario Bros. (World).nes",
      "file": "Super Mario Bros. (World).nes",
      "title": "Super Mario Bros.",
      "region": "World",
      "tags": ["World"],
      "year": 1985
    }
  ]
  ```

### 2. `GET /api/rom?file={filename}`
Streams the raw binary NES ROM file (`application/octet-stream`).
- **Query Parameter**: `file` (string) - Validated filename ending with `.nes`.
- **Security**: Strictly prevents path traversal (`..`, `/`, `\`).

### 3. `GET /api/cheats?game={filename}`
Fetches curated Game Genie and memory cheat codes for the specified ROM title.
- **Query Parameter**: `game` (string) - Title or ROM filename.
- **Response Format**: Array of cheat definitions with description, code, and default state.

---

## Privacy, Security & Legal Notice

- **No User Tracking**: NostaNES does not require account creation, logins, or cookies for tracking.
- **Client-Side Privacy**: Custom ROM files loaded by the user remain entirely in local browser memory and are never uploaded to any remote server.
- **Save State Privacy**: All save states, button mappings, and favorite games are stored locally on the user's device via standard browser storage (IndexedDB and LocalStorage).
- **Emulation Legality**: The emulator core is distributed under open-source licenses (GPL/MIT via Libretro and Nostalgist.js). Emulation technology is legal for running legally acquired ROM cartridges and homebrew software.
